title: Senior Devops & Cloud Engineer
job_description:
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. 5+ years of hands-on experience managing AWS infrastructure for multi-tenant or large-scale SaaS applications. Proven experience with auto-scaling, load balancing, and failover architectures. Deep knowledge of AWS services (EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, EFS, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, CodeDeploy, Security Groups). Expert in CI/CD pipeline setup using Jenkins. Strong experience with networking — VPC, subnets, VPN, route tables, NAT, firewalls, and DNS. Strong experience in Unix/Linux server administration and shell scripting. Strong knowledge of Cloudflare configuration (DNS, CDN, SSL, WAF). Experience in security hardening, IAM policies, TLS/SSL, and monitoring automation. Experience with AWS Lambda and Secrets Manager. Excellent troubleshooting and performance optimization skills.

Own and manage the entire AWS infrastructure stack (Development, UAT, Staging, Production). Design and operate multi-tenant SaaS environments with auto-scaling, load balancing, and cost optimization. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, AWS CodeBuild and AWS CodeDeploy. Configure and secure networking (VPC, subnets, routing, VPN, firewalls) and Cloudflare for DNS, CDN, and WAF. Manage Unix / server administration — patching, hardening, backup, and monitoring. Implement and monitor IAM policies, Secrets Manager, SSL/TLS, and access control. Set up monitoring and alerting (CloudWatch, Grafana, ELK, Prometheus). Enforce high-availability and disaster recovery (HA/DR) strategies. Automate infrastructure provisioning (CloudFormation / Terraform). Support application deployments and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks. Collaborate with developers to ensure consistent, reliable, and secure CI/CD deployments.

Annual Leave Medical and Hospitalisation Leave EPF SOCSO EIS Medical Insurance Training Provided Performance Bonus

AWS Jenkins Git CI/CD Software As A Service (SaaS)
